name: Repair Strip
description: Create 3 Repair Strips which can be used to repair Items.

name: Create Tools
description: Create 10 Lockpicks, 1 Crowbar, 1 Climbing Kit, 1 Complex Lock and Key, or 1 Compass.

name: Craft Ultra-Light Ranged Weapon
description: Creates an Ultra-Light Ranged Weapon using either an Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot, a Mechanical Part and a Strip of Light Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Craft Light Ranged Weapon
description: Creates a Light Ranged Weapon using either an Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingot, Mechanical Parts and a Strip of Heavy Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 3.

name: Craft Heavy Ranged Weapon
description: Creates a Heavy Ranged Weapon using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots, Mechanical Parts and a Strip of Heavy Leather. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 3 and Starsteel 4.

name: Silencing Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished ranged weapon to make reduced noise

name: Net Launcher Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished ranged weapon to be able to shoot a Net as a projectile.

name: Grapple Launcher Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished ranged weapon to be able to shoot a Grappling hook with 5 Units of Rope.
ingredients: Grappling Hook, 2 Mechanical Parts, 15 ft. Rope [5 Units]

name: Handguard Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished Light or Heavy Ranged Weapon to grant +1 Block.

name: Farshot Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished ranged weapon to increase the maximum range by 2

name: Nearshot Infusion
description: Infuse an unfinished ranged weapon to reduce the minimum range by 2

name: Launcher Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished gloves, ranged weapon or arcanatech arm with an infusion that has an ammo capacity of 1 and can store a small object, a piece of throwing ammunition or a potion. As an action, the wearer can shoot the stored item as a projectile with an attack modifier equal to the engineering skill at the time of crafting up to a number of units equal to 10 + the engineering skill at the time of crafting with a damage bonus of 4.

name: Timer
description: Create a Timer that can be attached to a Potion to Activate it. The timer can be set between 1 Round to 1 Hour.

name: Door Trigger
description: Creates a Trigger that can be attached to a Trap to activate it. This trap triggers when a door opens or closes.  This trap can be seen with a Search Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted and be disarmed with an Engineering Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted.

name: Needle Trap
description: The creature that triggers this trap must make an Initiative Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time of crafting or they are stuck by a needle. This needle can be coated with poison or some other vial of liquid.

name: Net Trap
description: The creature that triggers this trap must make an Acrobatics or Athletics Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time of crafting or they caught in the net, suffering its effects.

name: Step Trigger
description: Creates a Trigger that can be attached to a Trap to activate it. This trap triggers when a creature steps on a 1 Unit Square area where it is placed. This trap can be seen with a Search Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted and be disarmed with an Engineering Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted.

name: Touch Trigger
description: Creates a Trigger that can be attached to a Trap to activate it. This trap triggers when a creature touches the object this trap is placed on. This trap can be seen with a Search Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted and be disarmed with an Engineering Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted.

name: Potion Trap
description: If a creature triggers this trap, they are subjected to the potions being activated within 1 Unit of them.

name: Dart Trap
description: The creature that triggers this trap has a piece of ammunition fired at them that counts as an Attack Roll equal to 5 + the Engineering Skill at the time of crafting, dealing 1d8 Damage plus the Engineering Skill.

name: Cave-in Trap
description: The creature that triggers this trap must make an Initiative Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time of crafting or either fall through the floor in the case of a fall trap or be struck by something above in the case of a ceiling trap.

name: Conditional Trigger
description: Creates a Trigger that can be attached to a Trap to activate it. This trap triggers when a creature fulfills a specific condition specified at the time of crafting. This trap can be seen with a Search Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted and be disarmed with an Engineering Check equal to the Engineering Skill at the time it was crafted.

name: Activation Trap
description: The creature that triggers this trap is subjected to an item being activated and whatever that may entail.
